svg.title: The FLAIR Privacy Boundary
svg.desc: A figure with a vertical hatched band down the centre labelled "Privacy boundary — patient data never crosses". Code crosses the boundary rightward in the upper region (a containerised model with a SHA-256 stamp); aggregate JSONs cross leftward in the lower region (four files, cell-suppressed). The left side holds the developer workflow, the FLAIR aggregator, and a per-site forest-plot leaderboard. The right side holds a 4-by-3 grid of 12+ institutional silos, each with a data-steward icon and a padlock.
svg.text: Code crosses rightward · only aggregate JSONs return · patient data does not.
PUBLIC SIDE · researcher · Model Owner · FLAIR Portal · leaderboard
12+ INSTITUTIONAL SILOS · data stays here · no internet · no root · immutable image

g.text: reviews task PRs (single-file modules) · approves models
approval gates what crosses the boundary & runs at sites
registers tasks + models · distributes containers · hosts models · verifies SHA-256 · merges
same bytes execute at every site
aggregate JSONs only · cell-suppression at n<10 · SHA-256 chain
each silo: container runs in CLIF-WorkBench; only aggregate JSONs leave the site
catalog grows by GitHub pull request · acceptance via MIMIC-CLIF reproducibility + clinical review + site-governance review
